title: Garlic Parmesan Monkey Bread
description: Green onions, parsley, garlic powder, butter, eggs, Parmesan cheese, and bread dough come together in this savory garlic Parmesan monkey bread recipe.
ingredients: 2 (1 pound) loaves frozen bread dough, thawed

steps.text: Grease a 10-inch Bundt pan or tube pan.
Combine butter, green onion, parsley, eggs, garlic powder, and salt in a medium bowl until well blended. Break bread dough into walnut-sized pieces; dip into egg mixture.

Place 1 layer egg-dipped dough pieces into the prepared pan until bottom is covered; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Repeat dipping, layering, and sprinkling until all dough pieces and Parmesan are in the pan. Loosely cover the pan; let rise until doubled in volume, about 45 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

video.description: Do you know you’re gonna have a hungry group later? Put this delicious pull-apart monkey bread appetizer together in your Bundt pan and you’ll have dedicated fans ever after! Mix together green onion with parsley, garlic powder, salt, butter and eggs, then dip walnut-sized pieces of bread in the eggy mixture and layer into a greased Bundt pan. Sprinkle in some Parmesan cheese, then repeat the dipped bread and cheese layers. Allow to rise and bake up golden and tempting. Pop out of the pan and serve as is, or offer dipping sauces such as cheese or marinara.
